thread:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: Pager trigger — p99 latency alert for /v1/embeddings (region: us-west). p99 = 2.8s, threshold 1.2s. Impact: increased tail latency for customer inference. Incident link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/6387654321

alex: saw this, on it. I'm primary for the shift but finishing a handover call in 5m, ping if it worsens.

maria: I'm secondary. covering while alex wraps? I can jump in now.

jon: quick check — any recent deploys to embeddings-svc in last 30m? CI shows a canary earlier but not full rollout.

sam: logs show a spike of KV cache misses to redis-kv-1 around the same time. Errors: `timeout reading from redis` with ~300ms tails.

linda: metrics — batch size for embeddings requests spiked (auto-batcher). There's a backlog increasing on pod e2e-embedding-2. Heap/CPU ok, but network latency to redis is up.

alex: ok prioritizing: 1) confirm customer impact, 2) quick mitigation (fallback model variant / disable batching), 3) investigate KV latency root cause. Maria, can you take step 2? I'll handle 1 and 3.

maria: taking step 2. Will disable continuous batching for embeddings route and flip fallback to smaller model-embed-002. Applying in staging then prod.

maria: executing change — `kubectl patch deployment embeddings-svc -n prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"redwood/disable-batcher":"true"}}}}}'`

oncall-coordinator: FYI @alex @maria add a brief note in the handover doc when resolved: https://redwood.internal/oncall/handovers/2026-03

sam: while batching is disabled, we should also temporarily route high-volume customers to dedicated variant with local cache. Quick route command: `curl -X POST https://router.redwood.internal/route -d '{"route":"embed_local_cache","selector":"high_volume"}'`

maria: change applied in prod. Disabling batcher reduced queue length on pod e2e-embedding-2 almost immediately.

alex: confirming customer impact — support dashboard shows elevated error budget usage for a handful of high-throughput tenants but no broad outage. Notifying support to throttle where safe.

jon: checking redis cluster — noticed one replica node with 5% packet loss in us-west-2. Network team pinged. Could explain KV tail.

linda: metrics after change: p99 dropped to 1.1s in 3m. Great. We should keep the fallback route for 15–30m while infra stabilizes.

maria: re-enabled fallback model for all prod routes to be safe. Command used: `redwoodctl rollout fallback --service embeddings-svc --variant model-embed-002 --duration 30m`

alex: thanks. Next steps: (A) infra to remediate redis pod (jon to coordinate), (B) keep batcher disabled for 30m, (C) prepare rollback path for the config change.

jon: pinged infra, they've isolated the flapping network interface and are evacuating the troubled redis replica. ETA 12 min.

sam: documenting quick runbook steps here for the next person taking over — paste into handover note: 
```
Quick KV-cache fallback play:
1) Disable continuous batching: `kubectl patch deployment embeddings-svc -n prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"redwood/disable-batcher":"true"}}}}}'`
2) Enable fallback model: `redwoodctl rollout fallback --service embeddings-svc --variant model-embed-002 --duration 30m`
3) Route high-volume tenants to local-cache pool: `curl -X POST https://router.redwood.internal/route -d '{"route":"embed_local_cache","selector":"high_volume"}'`
4) Monitor p99 in dashboards: https://metrics.redwood.internal/d/embeddings
5) If no improvement in 10m: revert latest canary: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/embeddings-svc -n prod --to-revision=<canary-rev>`
```

maria: copying that into the handover doc. Also adding: contacts — infra oncall (pager 2), network (pager 1).

alex: great. I'll stay on for 15 more minutes to watch the metrics and then handoff to @maria if stable. If infra can't fully repair redis within window, escalate to SRE lead.

oncall-coordinator: note for incoming primary: expected state at handover: batcher disabled, fallback variant active, redis replica being rebuilt (ticket #INC-8842). Please run post-handoff checklist in the link.

linda: p99 steady at 1.05s for 5m. Looks good to hand off in 10.

maria: ready to accept primary at handover. I'll include short remediation notes and the command snippets above. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Incident update: mitigation applied (batcher disabled + fallback). Severity: mitigated. Update ticket INC-8842 with final resolution when fixed.

alex: handing off to @maria now. Leaving logs and snippets in the handover doc. Thanks team.

maria: acknowledged — taking primary. Will post if anything regresses.
